task: DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001 Day 2 — readiness plan C2: ledger segments and retention (seal/roll, cross-segment chain, Article 12 §4 retention classes, operator-confirmed prune)

checks.name: segments suite passes
checks.run: npx vitest run src/__tests__/aegis-pilot-segments.test.ts src/__tests__/aegis-pilot.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}

checks.name: CLI seal + segments verify, prune without --confirm deletes nothing
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); P='node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts'; $P init --state-dir $d/s --site-id c2-check >/dev/null && $P seal --state-dir $d/s --force | grep -q '"sealed": true' && $P segments --state-dir $d/s >/dev/null && $P prune --state-dir $d/s | grep -q '"confirmed": false' && test -f $d/s/ledger/segments/000000.jsonl

checks.name: tampered sealed segment fails verification (exit 4)
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); P='node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts'; $P init --state-dir $d/s --site-id c2-check >/dev/null && $P seal --state-dir $d/s --force >/dev/null && sed -i 's/system.genesis/system.heartbeat/' $d/s/ledger/segments/000000.jsonl; $P segments --state-dir $d/s >/dev/null; [ $? -eq 4 ]

checks.name: isolated rehearsal still PASSes after a roll
checks.run: command -v unshare >/dev/null || { echo 'SKIP: unshare missing'; exit 0; }; d=$(mktemp -d); bash scripts/aegis-pilot-isolated-rehearsal.sh "$d/s" >/dev/null 2>&1; node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts seal --state-dir "$d/s" --force >/dev/null && bash scripts/aegis-pilot-isolated-rehearsal.sh "$d/s" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"outcome": "PASS"' && node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts segments --state-dir "$d/s" >/dev/null
